thread:
nina (PM): Quick sync: exec asked whether we cut the "embedding-optimizer" feature for MVP to keep deadline. Need a clear tradeoff decision.

kevin (ENG): embedding-optimizer is 2 sprints of infra + eval work. It materially reduces per-query cost but not required for core generation flow.

tara (UX): dropping it simplifies onboarding copy and reduces surface area. but customers who requested it will be unhappy. we can highlight as a v1 performance upgrade.

jude (SRE): ops-wise, removing it reduces infra complexity and rollout risk. fewer kernels to test at launch.

matt (AE): we have two mid-market prospects explicitly asking for it. they'd likely pilot without it if we give a roadmap date and compensating SLA.

nina (PM): options: A) delay MVP 3 weeks to include optimizer. B) ship MVP on time without it, commit to v1 perf improvements in 60 days and offer early-access to paying pilots. Vote?

kevin (ENG): vote B. Preserves public momentum. We can target a v1 perf sprint and prioritize infra for known customers.

tara (UX): B + add a banner in the docs: "Performance pack (v1) incoming; sign up for early access". keeps expectations clear.

jude (SRE): B but require a canary plan for any perf toggles when optimizer ships. we'll add a rollback toggle and rate limits.

matt (AE): B if we put a firm delivery window in writing (60 days) and offer discount for early-access. I can negotiate.

release-bot: deploy 3156789200 -> staging/product succeeded :rocket:

nina (PM): consensus = B. Action items:
- nina: update roadmap + customer comms; draft early-access offer (today).
- kevin: reprioritize optimizer to v1 sprint; create spike tickets (2d).
- jude: prepare canary/rollback plan and tests (5d).
- tara: doc/banner copy + sign-up form (3d).
- matt: reach out to prospects with the offer and get verbal OK (EOD).

kevin (ENG): adding ticket: PERF-342 optimizer spike + benchmark harness.

matt (AE): spoke to Prospect Z; they'll pilot early-access if we confirm 60d window. legal wants soft language.

nina (PM): keep updates here. if any item slips beyond assigned due dates flag immediately. thanks. :thumbsup:
